skills.name: 托孤
skills.text: 当一名角色死亡时，你可以令其选择其武将牌上的一个技能（限定技、觉醒技、主公技和包含隐匿的技能除外），你失去上次以此法获得的技能，然后获得此技能。

skills.name: 擅专
skills.text: 当你对一名其他角色造成伤害后，若其判定区没有牌，你可以将其一张牌置于其判定区，若此牌不是延时锦囊牌，则红色牌视为【乐不思蜀】，黑色牌视为【兵粮寸断】。结束阶段，若你本回合未造成伤害，你可以摸一张牌。

interpretation: Tuogu uses the deceased general printed skill definitions, including both printed cards where applicable, never all acquired runtime skills; Limited/Awakening/Lord and any skill name/description containing 隐匿 are excluded. The deceased is the actual private chooser even though dead.

Each Tuogu inheritance owns a separate grant, replacing only the exact prior Tuogu grant. An original or separately granted same-name skill remains intact; existing effective skill instances are shared to preserve quotas.

Shanzhuan moves one eligible owned physical hand/equipment card into an entirely empty, available judgment area. It is a placement, not a Use or a delayed-trick targeting event. A printed delayed trick retains its original kind; otherwise its actual owner-effective suit determines red Indulgence or black SupplyShortage.
Native judgment-effective-kind storage follows the physical entity when transferred within Judgment and is cleared when it leaves Judgment; later re-entry requires a new placement or Use.
The ending draw checks actual damage dealt during the current actual turn, not declarations or prevented damage.
validation: Root integrated focused verification passes all four native behavior checks: deceased private printed-skill choice, exact prior inherited-grant replacement and source-pile cleanup; actual red/black/printed delayed placement and Judgment transfer/later leave; native Silver Lion recovery replacement cold returns; actual dealt-damage ending draw.
